definitions.gloss: retrial; judicial review; re-examination of a case
definitions.explanation: A legal proceeding in which a previously decided case is tried again, typically because new evidence has emerged or procedural errors are alleged.

examples.japanese: {再審|さいしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{認|みと}められた→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
{弁護団|べんごだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{再審|さいしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{請求|せいきゅう}した→請求する：26988_seikyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: The defense team filed for a retrial.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかり→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧、⟦{三十|さんじゅう}→三十：00984_sanjuu⟧⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{再審|さいしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ことになった。
examples.english: New evidence was found, and a retrial will be held for the first time in thirty years.

notes:
USAGE:
{再審|さいしん} is a legal term frequently seen in news reports about criminal cases, especially wrongful convictions. Japan's retrial system is notoriously difficult to navigate, making {再審|さいしん} cases major news events.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再審|さいしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{請求|せいきゅう}する→請求する：26988_seikyuusuru⟧ (to file for a retrial)
- {再審|さいしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{認|みと}められる→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧ (for a retrial to be granted)
- {再審|さいしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ (for a retrial to be held)
- {再審|さいしん}⟦{無罪|むざい}→無罪：13383_muzai⟧ (acquittal on retrial)
- {再審|さいしん}⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧⟦{決定|けってい}→決定：02701_kettei⟧ (decision to begin a retrial)
